label: Individuating non-present candidates: the axiarchic rival and the cognition criterion (#2145 lane C)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'Individuating non-present candidates: the axiarchic rival and the cognition criterion'. Follows attempt e03ee9b6 (Lane 4), which recorded the cognition criterion 3b40009e as a direct assumption at parity with the axiarchic rival. Question: to favour x over y by value before either exists, where are x and y individuated? Verified result 1895c9f3 (goodGeneralFavouringIsApprehensionOfIndividuation, zero-axiom main theorem) derives 3b40009e from excluded middle ee4ab504, item realization 633d5c29 (a favouring profile is the inverse image of a relation, indexed by bearer, profile and scenario, among the bearer's stand-in items), irreflexivity 3ca01752, the own-favouring bridge 65805e5a (no independent stand-in for a non-present candidate), the source-of-differences bridge 69b9f887 (no merely produced stand-in) and the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 (a contained stand-in that individuates a non-present candidate in a value-dependent favouring is a content about it that the bearer apprehends; the declared sense bridge from CONTAINED_IN_1 to CONTAINED_IN_2). Given the other five premises d1fb6414 is strictly stronger than the criterion (Lean-only criterionGivesWeakRecognition and weakRecognitionGivesCriterion; Comparator companion criterionDoesNotGiveRecognition), so the derivation localizes the dispute and adds no warrant against a rival granting those premises; realization and irreflexivity only discharge the individuation conjunct (recognitionWithoutIndividuationGivesCriterion). Lean-only unindividuatedNotFavoured: realized irreflexive favouring never favours one of two candidates sharing a stand-in over the other (the nowhere horn). Comparator companion axiarchicControls on Lane 4's carrier: personal row with every premise; one row per failing premise (contained unapprehended stand-ins; independent realm; produced realm; one undifferentiated item, where no item relation realizes the favouring; a formally good-general non-contrastive favouring that favours an outcome over itself). Findings: the rival's positive accounts are creative requiredness (independent realm), aligned powers (contained; law 3 makes value-dependence a coincidence of the power order with the value order on the witnessing pair(s), since GoodGeneral needs only one pair at one scenario; whole-order coincidence, the D-nature's alignment price generalized, would need an unregistered stronger premise (Lean-only witnessOnlyAlignment: agreement on the witness, disagreement elsewhere)), and imitability exemplars (contained; value and favouring share the source's nature as ground; the divine-ideas structure without understanding, the #1892 objective-eminence status). Horn 1 does not conflict with (b) as encoded (ActualRoot concerns concrete grounds only); it conflicts with an inclusive sole-foundation reading, which is not registered, and its price (plural or value-first ultimacy) falls equally on a demiurge. The produced realm reduces to source containment by the source-of-differences demand, or (Plotinian) to a producer with no contrastive favouring, i.e. the final-cause-as-object rival of 980e6482. What is derived is containment of the stand-in (CONTAINED_IN_1, intentional or virtual), by a disjunctive syllogism over the two locus bridges; not that value is present non-causally. Horn 2 meets every typed property of Apprehends and About under a stretched About; the separating property is intentional versus virtual containment (CONTAINED_IN_2 versus CONTAINED_IN_3). Natural-case search (selection, homeostasis, etiological function, prices, least action, reinforcement learners): each favouring factors through a proxy that demonstrably diverges from value; no case passes; none counted as independent evidence. Symmetry: the same trilemma for the personal account, with matching occupants and prices horn by horn; individuation price shared (#1879); alignment is avoided on both sides only by grounding value in the source, after which ideas and imitability modes differ only in being understood. Rejected approaches: encoding a free requiredness or efficacy predicate (a flag, not a formalization); using 'relations of reason exist only in an intellect' against the imitability rival (definitional, question-begging); counting the absence of a natural case as evidence. Independent semantic challenge of 1c4d003b9..2fdafb853: result valid, controls and parity accepted; five P1s (relocation presented as gain; non-causal presence overclaimed; realization forced one favouring per bearer; realization prose wider than its type; converse and question-begging warrant items) and eight P2s repaired at 0692e4910 (profile-indexed item relation, comparison lemmas, CONTAINED_IN disambiguation, Produces restricted to production, control artifacts and About stretch disclosed, sub-personal objection recorded as no substantive objection for value-dependent cases). Targeted re-check at 28f063a95 accepted those repairs, the F3 type change and the revised judgment; one residual P1 (an A4 condition misattributed to realization instead of the independent locus) and three P2s (CONTAINED_IN tags not type-enforced; virtual-containment and intentional-containment definition wording) were fixed in the following commit. Codex review on PR-2175 at b508b3721: two P1s repaired in the following commit (A3 price restricted to the witnessed pairs with the witnessOnlyAlignment model; containment senses moved into the bound types: Independent, NoMerelyProducedStandIn and the recognition antecedent use ContainsGenerically, its consequent ContainsIntentionally, the argument records CONTAINED_IN_1 with d1fb6414 as sense bridge; bound types of 65805e5a, 69b9f887 and d1fb6414 changed).
blocker: Not blocked. The residual dispute is the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 at the intentional/virtual containment boundary: whether a plurality of value-ranked modes of imitability in one simple nature, guiding its favouring, can be mind-independent without being real composition or real relations to non-existents (the #1892 objective-eminence status). Next tests: encode IntrinsicExemplarEminence with a favouring realized on contained modes and ConstitutivelySimple; a root-restricted recognition bridge with simplicity as a premise; aligned powers versus the D-nature as a configuration; check whether the Plotinian produced-realm structure is exactly the final cause as object.

current_assessment.scope: Individuation of non-present candidates for a value-responsive source; the cognition criterion and the axiarchic rival under one standard
current_assessment.assessment: No change in the cognition criterion's overall warrant; the change is localization. The criterion keeps its direct-assumption option and gains a registered conditional derivation (1895c9f3), but given the other five premises its last premise d1fb6414 is strictly stronger than the criterion, so against the contained-unapprehended rivals (aligned powers, imitability exemplars), which grant those five, the dispute is relocated with no warrant change. What is derived is containment of the non-present candidate's stand-in (intentional or virtual) from excluded middle and two locus bridges each denying one horn; the nowhere horn is excluded in Lean under realization and irreflexivity, which only discharge the individuation conjunct. Leslie-type creative requiredness is localized at 65805e5a, with a price at a root (not the sole ultimate at the inclusive scope) conditional on an unregistered inclusive reading of (b). Aligned powers additionally pay an unexplained coincidence of their order with value on the witnessed pairs (whole-order coincidence only under an unregistered stronger premise); noncognitive imitability exemplarism stands at parity (the #1892 objective-eminence gap). The individuation price under simplicity is shared, and both sides avoid alignment only by grounding value in the source. No premise discharged, no unconditional ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: Can a mind-independent plurality of value-ranked modes in one simple nature be distinguished from real composition by anything typed (IntrinsicExemplarEminence with ConstitutivelySimple)? A root-restricted recognition bridge with simplicity; aligned powers versus the D-nature as a configuration; the Plotinian produced realm against the final cause as object. Register the inclusive sole-foundation reading of (b) as a sibling statement.
